reason: I only get Saturdays, so a $59 membership is maybe four visits and that's no better than paying $12 a go, and money is tight since daycare went up. It sounds like CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor, and I'm not locking into a monthly fee for a place that hasn't opened yet.
objection: Why pay more than CoCo's for a once-a-week Saturday visit when I can't prove it's actually different or that it will still be around in a year?
would_change_my_mind: A pay-as-you-go option with no commitment (like a 5-visit pass) and a free first visit to see if it's really better than CoCo's, once it has actually opened.
